label.description: Original abbreviated appointment name (SHORT APPT) — preserved verbatim, never expanded.

usage_count.description: Number of history rows carrying this label.

distinct_employees.description: Number of distinct personnel who have held this label.

current_holders.description: Number of personnel whose open-ended appointment carries this label.

validation_status.description: HR validation state. Identical labels are NOT assumed to be the same unique position until validated.

merged_into.description: Label this entry has been merged into, if HR has validated the merge.

grooming_tier.description: HR grooming tag. P1 = highest-visibility grooming appointment (top half of the tagged 5%), P2 = the next band. Empty when the appointment carries no grooming tag.

speciality.description: Vocation the appointment is tied to, derived from the vocations of whoever has held it: FIGHTER, TRANSPORT, HELICOPTER, AWO, UAV, AIR INTEL, NAVIGATOR, AIRCREW or ANYAIR (generalist, open to any air vocation).

speciality_evidence.description: Basis for the speciality tag — the share of recorded holders who carry that vocation.

tier_basis.description: Basis for the grooming tier — the recorded holding count that placed this appointment in the tagged band.
